only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.22), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool2' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.0051. Series context: trend strength 0.996 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.22); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.481.
